title: Competition Is Irrelevant When Founder Clarity Is Strong
primary_theme: FinTech investing through sector specialization and founder clarity
founder_lessons: Explain competition calmly by showing what others do, what you do, and how it is different.
Choose investors who can be a constructive first call when bad news arrives.
Build around a theme with a large enough market and a founder capable of advancing the investor's thinking.
Do not overreact to short market selloffs; use financial discipline without abandoning long-term company building.
notable_quotes: He wasn't "we're going to crush them". It wasn't "they're terrible". It was, "here's what they do, here's what we do, and here's how it's different."
I want it to say, "He was my first call".
nothing makes me happier than being that first money in.
